selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What season is the afternoon prayer time compared to?
questions.answer: It is compared to autumn.

questions.question: What is remembered through those comparisons for the afternoon prayer time?
questions.answer: Allah’s acts and merciful gifts are remembered.

questions.question: What does the sunset prayer time teach by reminding us of creatures leaving?
questions.answer: It teaches that life in this world does not last.

questions.question: What human event does the sunset prayer time bring to mind?
questions.answer: It brings death to mind.

questions.question: What wrong state of mind does the sunset prayer time shake a person out of?
questions.answer: It shakes a person out of heedlessness.

questions.question: What is one reason the nightfall prayer time feels heavy and serious in the passage?
questions.answer: Because it reminds people of darkness, loss, and the end of the testing world.

questions.question: How is winter described in relation to the earth?
questions.answer: It is described as covering the dead earth like a white burial cloth.

questions.question: What does the closing of the testing world suggest about worldly life?
questions.answer: It suggests that worldly life is not forever and will come to an end.

questions.question: What can we understand from the phrase that this world is a place of examination?
questions.answer: We are here for a test, not to stay forever.

questions.question: Which prayer time is compared to the later part of life?
questions.answer: The afternoon prayer time.

questions.question: Which part of a person’s life matches that same prayer time?
questions.answer: The later years of life.

questions.question: What natural change is used at sunset to remind people of endings?
questions.answer: The passing away of many creatures at the end of autumn.

questions.question: What does the passage say leaves at the end of autumn?
questions.answer: Many creatures leave and pass away.

questions.question: What effect should sunset have on a careless person?
questions.answer: It should wake that person up from spiritual carelessness.

questions.question: At nightfall, what happens to the things people saw during the day?
questions.answer: They are hidden by darkness.

questions.question: What two kinds of covering are used to describe night and winter?
questions.answer: One is a black covering over the world, and the other is a white burial covering over the earth.

questions.question: What does the passage say will happen to this world as a place of testing?
questions.answer: It will be shut down forever.

questions.question: Which prayer time in this passage most strongly points to the final closing of worldly life?
questions.answer: The nightfall prayer time.

questions.question: What three comparisons are given for the afternoon prayer time?
questions.answer: It is compared to autumn, old age, and the blessed time of the Final Prophet, peace be upon him.

questions.question: What do those afternoon reminders show about Allah?
questions.answer: They show His acts and merciful favors.

questions.question: What does the sunset prayer time make a person remember about living things?
questions.answer: It makes a person remember that many creatures leave and pass away.

questions.question: How does the sunset prayer time connect to the whole world?
questions.answer: It reminds people that the world will one day be destroyed.

questions.question: What should happen to a person’s heart when sunset is understood correctly?
questions.answer: The heart should wake up and become more aware.

questions.question: Which prayer time is linked with the season when leaves often fall and things begin to fade?
questions.answer: The afternoon prayer time.
